RIPPERS.Guise.IdentityHint: The persona behind the mask (e.g. Inspector Grange)
RIPPERS.Guise.RoleHint: One-line cover / how it reads on the street
RIPPERS.Guise.DropClass: Drop a class Item here to add it to this guise
RIPPERS.Guise.DropSkill: Drop a skill Item here (allocate its SL below)
RIPPERS.Guise.DropEquip: Drop a weapon / armour / accessory here
RIPPERS.Guise.SwapHint: Click this guise on the character sheet to bind it (dismissing any other). Exactly one guise is active at a time; its skills, equipment and affinities apply only while it is bound.
RIPPERS.Guise.DormancyHint: While this guise is bound, your own innate skills sleep — only the mask's allocated skills are live (one 30-level set at a time). Dismiss the guise to wake them.
